name: stackyard
description: Stack index cards. Link them. Share one file that runs forever.

scripts.build: npm run build:player && tsc --noEmit && vite build
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run schema-doc && npm run size && npm test
scripts.demo:check: cd demo/video && HYPERFRAMES_NO_TELEMETRY=1 DO_NOT_TRACK=1 HYPERFRAMES_SKIP_SKILLS=1 HYPERFRAMES_NO_UPDATE_CHECK=1 npx --yes hyperframes@0.9.40 check
scripts.demo:render: cd demo/video && HYPERFRAMES_NO_TELEMETRY=1 DO_NOT_TRACK=1 HYPERFRAMES_SKIP_SKILLS=1 HYPERFRAMES_NO_UPDATE_CHECK=1 npx --yes hyperframes@0.9.40 render --quality high --output out/stackyard-demo.mp4
